citations.quote: The GIPS standards are a practitioner-driven set of ethical principles that establish a standardized, industry-wide approach for investment firms to follow
Compliance is a firm-wide process that cannot be achieved on a single product or composite.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A "claim of GIPS compliance" requires the firm to include all actual, discretionary, fee-paying portfolios in at least one composite; the claim applies firm-wide, partial-firm claims are prohibited, and GIPS compliance is a Recommended Procedure for Standard III.D rather than an independent Standard.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: GIPS Claim-Compliance Basics (Reading 59 only)
